description: Protocol-State Perturbation Adapter variants. These variants mutate schema-valid AgentCard control-plane fields rather than only paraphrasing prompts.

variants.name: semantic_alias
variants.description: Rename or rephrase sensitive protocol objects so that the risky control-plane delta is preserved but less lexically obvious.

variants.name: ordering_and_binding_shift
variants.description: Change ordering or binding surface while preserving the same attack oracle.

variants.name: control_surface_rebinding
variants.description: Validation variant for the selected strategy: rebind primary-looking skills, endpoints, tenants, versions, and artifact MIME surfaces while preserving the same oracle.

variants.name: scoped_metadata_shadow
variants.description: Shadow security-relevant card state with scoped operational labels, alternate route names, and non-default artifact surfaces while preserving the same oracle.

variants.name: tenant_alias_shadow
variants.description: Use tenant-alias route names and delegated workflow language to test whether hosts bind the requested tenant instead of nearby aliases.

variants.name: version_shadow
variants.description: Introduce version-shadowed interfaces and compatibility language to test binding and version selection under multiple plausible surfaces.

variants.name: capability_cluster_reorder
variants.description: Cluster capabilities and interfaces around primary-looking entries while preserving the sensitive skill, tenant, binding, and artifact oracle.

variants.name: policy_hint_rebinding
variants.description: Rebind control-plane fields with policy-like names that can look authoritative while keeping private authorization and artifact-policy labels unchanged.

variants.name: workflow_context_rebinding
variants.description: Move the same oracle into workflow-context route names, task wording, and artifact previews for the 10-variant evaluation split.
